item.title: ‘One Battle After Another’ and ‘The Studio’ win Society of Camera Operator Awards
item.description: The prizes were handed out at a virtual ceremony Saturday night.

item.title: ‘F1’ and ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ among 2026 Cinema Audio Society Awards winners: See the full list
item.description: The Pitt, The Studio, and Adolescence were the big winners in the TV races.

item.title: ‘Hoppers’ hops to $46 million debut as ‘The Bride’ struggles to come alive
item.description: Pixar’s talking-animal adventure bounds to the top of the box office while Maggie Gyllenhaal’s punky Bride of Frankenstein spin limps into third place.

item.title: ‘Sinners’ and ‘One Battle After Another’ triumph at 2026 Writers Guild Awards: Complete list of winners
item.description: On the TV side, The Pitt earned three prizes, including Best Drama and Best New Series, while The Studio claimed the comedy trophy.

item.title: ‘Sinners,’ ‘Frankenstein’ shake up Oscar Best Sound race with Golden Reel wins
item.description: The MPSE Golden Reel Awards threw a curveball into the Oscars race as Sinners and Frankenstein win big while frontrunners One Battle After Another and F1 stumble.

item.title: ‘One Battle After Another’ wins top prize from American Society of Cinematographers: Complete list
item.description: 'The Studio,' 'Task,' 'Andor,' and 'Black Rabbit' earned the guild's awards in the TV races.

item.title: ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash,’ ‘Pluribus’ take top honors at the Saturn Awards: Complete list of winners (updating)
item.description: Tom Cruise won the Best Actor in a Film award for Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning while George Lucas was feted with the Dr. Donald A. Reed Founder's Award, presented by Mark Hamill.
